atoms.exact_source_text: The Gathering Place supports the teaching and interpretation of Laws, Sayings and storytelling, civic ceremonies, After-name recognition, Maturity and arrival observances, memorial practices, the recounting of Chronicle material, and Council-centered cultural events.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Gathering Place supports teaching/interpretation of Laws and Sayings, storytelling, civic ceremonies, After-name recognition, Maturity and arrival observances, memorial practices, recounting of Chronicle material, and Council-centered cultural events.

atoms.exact_source_text: Each Core civilization gives the Gathering Place its own architectural form and in-world name.
atoms.normalized_claim: Each Core civilization gives the Gathering Place its own architectural form and in-world name.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Rabbit Gathering Place may plausibly be a court or Story Circle.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Rabbit Gathering Place may plausibly be a court or Story Circle.

atoms.exact_source_text: Mouse and Squirrel expressions must arise from their own spatial identities rather than reproducing the Rabbit arrangement underground or aloft.
atoms.normalized_claim: Mouse and Squirrel Gathering Place expressions must arise from their own spatial identities rather than reproducing the Rabbit arrangement underground or aloft.

atoms.exact_source_text: Species-specific names remain for a later Place-nomenclature pass.
atoms.normalized_claim: Species-specific names for the Gathering Place remain deferred for a later Place-nomenclature pass.

atoms.exact_source_text: **Gathering Place** is the canonical functional label.
atoms.normalized_claim: Gathering Place is the canonical functional label.

atoms.exact_source_text: **Story Circle** may remain a Rabbit-specific expression.
atoms.normalized_claim: Story Circle may remain a Rabbit-specific expression.

atoms.exact_source_text: **Circle** is deprecated as the universal term.
atoms.normalized_claim: Circle is deprecated as the universal term.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Gathering Place may be enclosed or open, centralized or distributed around a shared focus, level or vertically arranged, intimate or capable of receiving the larger Colony, purpose-built or gradually recognized through repeated use.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Gathering Place may be enclosed or open, centralized or distributed around a shared focus, level or vertically arranged, intimate or capable of receiving the larger Colony, and purpose-built or gradually recognized through repeated use.

atoms.exact_source_text: It is the place where the Colony gathers to say what its life means.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Gathering Place is the place where the Colony gathers to say what its life means.
BSA-09 Functional Recipe Classes is Adopted.

atoms.exact_source_text: Tools and Supplies are organized into a small number of canonical functional classes.
atoms.normalized_claim: Tools and Supplies are organized into a small number of canonical functional classes.

atoms.exact_source_text: Each class defines mechanical function, the circumstances in which it matters, whether it is persistent or consumed, and a simple resource recipe.
atoms.normalized_claim: Each functional class defines mechanical function, the circumstances in which it matters, whether it is persistent or consumed, and a simple resource recipe.

atoms.exact_source_text: Individual objects are manifestations of a class, not separate mechanical recipes.
atoms.normalized_claim: Individual objects are manifestations of a class, not separate mechanical recipes.

atoms.exact_source_text: Species-appropriate objects may share one class and one recipe while differing in form, material, scale, and cultural expression.
atoms.normalized_claim: Species-appropriate objects may share one class and one recipe while differing in form, material, scale, and cultural expression.

atoms.exact_source_text: Personal items use only these recipe shapes:
atoms.normalized_claim: Personal items use only certain recipe shapes.
A permitted personal-item recipe shape is 2 of one resource.
A permitted personal-item recipe shape is 1 + 1 of two resources.
A permitted personal-item recipe shape is 2 + 1 of two resources.
